INSERT INTO sanad_office_services (
  officeId, serviceName, serviceNameAr, category, description, descriptionAr,
  price, priceType, estimatedDeliveryDays, isActive, createdAt
) VALUES
-- Services for Muscat Business Services Center
((SELECT id FROM sanad_offices WHERE slug = 'muscat-business-center' LIMIT 1),
 'Company Registration', 'تسجيل الشركة', 'registration',
 'Complete company registration service', 'خدمة تسجيل الشركة الكاملة',
 500.000, 'fixed', 5, 1, NOW()),
 
((SELECT id FROM sanad_offices WHERE slug = 'muscat-business-center' LIMIT 1),
 'Trade License', 'رخصة تجارية', 'licensing',
 'Trade license application and renewal', 'طلب وتجديد الرخصة التجارية',
 300.000, 'fixed', 3, 1, NOW()),

-- Services for Salalah Legal Documentation Office  
((SELECT id FROM sanad_offices WHERE slug = 'salalah-legal-docs' LIMIT 1),
 'Document Translation', 'ترجمة المستندات', 'translation',
 'Professional document translation services', 'خدمات ترجمة مستندات احترافية',
 50.000, 'fixed', 1, 1, NOW()),
 
((SELECT id FROM sanad_offices WHERE slug = 'salalah-legal-docs' LIMIT 1),
 'Notarization Service', 'خدمة التوثيق', 'legal',
 'Official document notarization', 'توثيق المستندات الرسمية',
 75.000, 'fixed', 1, 1, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE serviceName=VALUES(serviceName);
